label: Step 1 • Knowledge
title: Learn the Basics
text: Understand your income, the real difference between "Needs vs Wants", and the 5 spending traps students often fall into.

label: Step 2 • Interactive
title: Practice
text: Practice sorting expenses in the student basket mini-game and pass a quick 5-question quiz to earn the Worker Bee badge.

label: Step 3 • Tools
title: Make a Plan
text: Use the 50-30-20 formula to calculate your budget automatically, set weekly savings goals and track every expense clearly.

label: Step 4 • Protection
title: Avoid Mistakes
text: A 3-question checklist before you scan a QR code to pay, the traps of pay-later wallets and credit cards, and answers from Bee Bot.
